name: field-cell
title: Field Cell
description: One display and one editor per field type — text, long text, number, currency, percent, date, date-time, choices, checkbox, person, link, file, URL, email, phone and the read-only computed types — for a grid cell (FieldCellEditor), a panel or a form (FieldInput), shown the same everywhere (FieldCellDisplay).

meta.whenToUse: Showing or editing a typed field value — a table's cells, a row panel, a record page's custom fields — so every surface shows and edits a type the same way.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single untyped inline edit (EditableCell), or a form field with its own validation and layout (Field + the control).
